 Teen Mom’s Tyler Baltierra Praises Wife Catelynn Lowell’s 30-Lb Weight Loss: ‘So Beyond Proud’
 By Miranda Siwak 
 November 1, 2026 
 TOP STORIES 
 Share on
 Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook 
 Share on X
 (Opens in new window) X 
 Courtesy of Tyler Baltierra/Instagram 
 Tap Here To Add Us Magazine As A Trusted Source
 Teen Mom star Catelynn Lowell has lost an impressive 30 pounds —  and her husband, Tyler Baltierra , is in awe of her weight loss journey.
 “ 🎃👻 HAPPY HALLOWEEN from The Baltierra’s! 👻🎃 ,” Tyler, 34, wrote via Instagram on Saturday, October 31, showing off his family’s Halloween costumes .
 Tyler dressed up as Nightwing, while Catelynn, 34, went as a witch to match their youngest daughter, Rya, 4. (In addition to Rya, Tyler and Catelynn also share Nova, 11, and Vaeda, 7, who dressed like Stick Man and Pennywise, respectively. The Teen Mom couple previously gave up their eldest daughter, Carly, for adoption upon her 2009 birth.)
 In a subsequent post, Tyler shouted out Catelynn for working hard to lose weight.
 Related: Teen Mom’s Tyler Baltierra Shares His Fitness Progress With NSFW Pic 
 Courtesy of Tyler Baltierra/Instagram Tyler Baltierra is proud of his body as he continues his fitness transformation. After posting a shirtless selfie in nothing but trunk underwear, the Teen Mom star decided to defend his NSFW picture and make it clear his wife, Catelynn Lowell, fully supports the posts. “Just so everyone is aware, my […] 
 “Can we just take a moment to acknowledge how beautiful my wife is!? She’s down 30lbs & I’m so beyond proud of her!” Tyler captioned a Sunday, November 1, before-and-after photo of Catelynn wearing the same witchy costume. “This is what we should all be talking about in regard to our Halloween photos.”
 He added, “I love you babe @catelynnmtv & you’re always the most beautiful to me! 🥰🤩😘 #MyBabe #Soulmate #Queen #SexyWitch.”
 While Catelynn has not publicly discussed her wellness journey, she previously made it clear that she wouldn’t stand for Tyler being anything less than supportive of her endeavors.
 Courtesy of Tyler Baltierra/Instagram 
 “If I was ever being body-shamed or called out of my name in front of my kids, I would be gone,” she quipped on a 2023 episode of Page Six’ s “Virtual Reali-Tea” podcast . “I don’t want my children to think that’s OK to be treated like that.”
 Catelyn has also supported Tyler’s own fitness goals.
 “I’m pretty happy with the results. It makes me even more pumped to see how the next cut goes after I’m done bulking again,” Tyler previously wrote via Instagram in August 2022. “I did decide to shift my goals a little and focus more on aesthetics/muscle building for this next bulk cycle, rather than strength building (like I was doing before).”
 Related: Teen Mom's Catelynn 'Would Be Gone' If Husband Tyler Ever Body-Shamed Her 
 Catelynn Lowell is shutting down fan speculation that husband Tyler Baltierra has criticized her body type. “If I was ever being body-shamed or called out of my name in front of my kids, I would be gone,” the Teen Mom: Next Chapter star, 31, said during a recent episode of Page Six’s “Virtual Reali-Tea” podcast. […] 
 He added, “I still have a long way to go until I reach my ultimate goal, but I promised myself that I would post more about my fitness journey, because It helps keep me accountable.”

 Tyler later decided to show off his new muscles via OnlyFans, with Catelynn’s blessing. 
 “To be completely fair, I’m NOT doing porn at all! Cate is just sharing the stuff that I personally send to her,” he explained via his Instagram Stories in July 2023. “There’s no sex involved or even videos on the page she’s running. … Cate is being completely transparent and honest about it all. It’s just a wife sharing photos of her husband, that’s literally it!”
